originalRequest.description:
Callback verification: reject stale x-callback-timestamp values, deduplicate x-callback-delivery-id, and verify x-callback-signature as HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + "
" + event + "
" + delivery-id + "
" + raw JSON body). Before delivery, all DNS answers are checked for private addresses and the connection is pinned to the validated public answers for that attempt, preventing hostname rebinding; retries use a new delivery ID and signature. ALLOW_PRIVATE_CALLBACKS=true is an explicit server-side override.

item.name: Binance Trading
item.description: Operator-only Binance Spot order workflow. Feature is disabled by default, uses Spot Testnet by default, fails closed without API-key or Firebase admin authentication, derives a deterministic clientOrderId for idempotent live retries, preserves decimal strings, distinguishes definitive Binance rejections from transient failures, and never retries an order submission automatically.
